notes.title: Update / Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Izanamiyako.
We have released an update with the following changes:

■ Updates

Camera Behavior Adjustment
Camera control, which was previously limited to left and right movement, can now also move vertically.

Voice Added to Title Screen
Japanese, English, and Chinese voices have been implemented.
(Please note: English and Chinese are for the title call only, not full voice-overs.)

We appreciate your continued support for Izanamiyako.

notes.title: August 22 – IzanamiYaKo – Release Confirmed!!
notes.notes: [p]This title is a stage-clear, Japanese-style escape horror action game where players must outwit pursuing spirits and find their way out of the dark labyrinth.[/p][p]With only limited vision, players must rely on sounds—such as footsteps and whispers—to sense approaching spirits and head toward the goal: the great torii gate. The controls are simple: just “Move” and “Dash.” But a single mistake could cost you your life, making every run a tense and thrilling experience.[/p][p]Immerse yourself in the chilling atmosphere of Japanese horror, where sound and sight merge to create a truly suspenseful escape.[/p][p]Trailer: 🔗[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XsspVwtZu24&t=5s"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]#IzanamiYako #HorrorGame #Steam #IndieGame #Release[/p]

notes.title: 【Update Announcement: “Izanami Yako” Now Supports English & Traditional Chinese!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529338/6a0897dd47495c0f64b22f0eb96c1fd2c46969c7.png[/img]
“Izanami Yako” has been updated to support English and Traditional Chinese subtitles!
Previously available only in Japanese, we have now added new subtitle options so more players can enjoy the game.

🔹 Available Languages

Voice: Japanese only
Subtitles: Japanese / English / Traditional Chinese
If you've already played, try experiencing the game again with the new subtitle options!
We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback!

🔻 Check out the Steam page here 🔻
